semantics.exact_statement: For every ell>=2 and m=ell-2, let P_m(x)=Pi_A_m x^{A_m} be a real homogeneous harmonic polynomial on R^3. Define L_S P_m=(S e).grad_R3 P_m|_{x=e}-(m+4)(e^T S e)P_m(e), equivalently (S e).grad_S2 P_m(e)-4(e^T S e)P_m(e). Prove their equivalence and the rank ell component -(ell+2)STF(S tensor Pi). Prove the Delta_l moment, Frobenius packed and conformal RHS adapters, and opposite LHS coefficient; independently compare the pinned source, without assuming its sign correctness.

symbol_type_domain_map.m: nonnegative integer ell-2 for the upper-coupling target
symbol_type_domain_map.x: ambient Cartesian vector in R^3, not constrained during differentiation
symbol_type_domain_map.P_m: P_m(x)=Pi_A_m x^{A_m}; homogeneous degree m with Euclidean Laplacian zero
symbol_type_domain_map.grad_R3: Cartesian partial derivatives partial/partial x_i in R^3, evaluated at x=e only after differentiating
symbol_type_domain_map.grad_S2: (I-e e^T) grad_R3 P_m|_{x=e}, the tangential gradient on the unit sphere
symbol_type_domain_map.L_S: proper-length pure-shear brightness generator defined in exact_statement

frame_signature_units_conventions.spatial_metric: Euclidean delta_ij in local orthonormal rest frame
frame_signature_units_conventions.c: c remains explicit in x0=c t and p=(epsilon/c)(u+e); s and eta are length-valued, ds=a d eta; no physical-seconds derivative without the c adapter
frame_signature_units_conventions.direct_expansion: Pi(e)=sum_l Pi_A_l e^{A_l}; all Pi_A_l spatial symmetric trace-free; J_A_l=integral Pi(e)e_<A_l> dOmega=Delta_l Pi_A_l
frame_signature_units_conventions.packed_coordinates: Q_l has Frobenius-orthonormal STF columns; pack(T)=Q_l^T vec(T), vec(unpack(v))=Q_l v; angular norm squared=Delta_l (T:T)
frame_signature_units_conventions.shear_time_adapter: S=sigma is geometric proper-length shear; if source supplies conformal Sigma, sigma=Sigma/a; conformal RHS=a times proper-length RHS, applied once

assumptions: collisionless massless occupation; initially isotropic case only for ell=2 oracle
pure-shear instantaneous local generator, no A/theta/omega/collision term in target coefficient
S and tensors real; full STF tensor domain
energy integrals and boundary operations justified by stated regularity
positivity_nonzero_conditions: finite nonzero brightness monopole for normalized ratios
branches: no complex branch; real STF primary coordinates
singular_loci: zero reference norm: use absolute equality, no relative division
order_of_limits: prove angular and energy identities before finite h or finite grid limits
no replacement of fixed-h quadrature convergence by h->0
boundary_or_initial_conditions: E^4 f(E,e) -> 0 as E->0 and infinity; E^3 f integrable
ell=0 and ell=1 have no ell-2 source

target.canonical_form: RHS_T9=-(ell+2) STF(S tensor Pi_{ell-2}); LHS_T9=+(ell+2) STF(...); moment LHS coefficient=(ell+2)ell(ell-1)/((2ell-1)(2ell+1)); packed via Q_l^T vec; conformal RHS multiplied by a
target.equivalence_relation: Exact STF/harmonic projection equality on declared full domain, not sampled tensor equality
invariants: sigma=Sigma/a and ds=a d eta applied once
exact_test_obligations: derive energy and angular terms from local collisionless transport with boundary justification
prove Euler identity e.grad_R3 P_m=m P_m and ambient/tangential generator equivalence; reject tangential grad combined with -(m+4)
exact m=1, ell=3 discriminator below; finite test does not discharge general-ell proof
prove homogeneous harmonic polynomial upper projection for all ell>=2
prove spherical STF orthogonality and Delta_l/Delta_l-2 relation
prove Frobenius pack/unpack and parity equivariance
handle ell=0,1 and S=0, arbitrary STF source
audit source full/packed cache/photon/shared massless-neutrino sign flow; proposed candidate would require separate RED->GREEN and old-sign mutation
